# CONTRACT
## Resource targets
- [ ] **Advisory goal:** Seek fewer routed Slice LUTs than the baseline of 55 on `xc7a35tcpg236-1`; record the routed count and whether it is below 55, even if the experiment finds no reduction.

## Timing targets
- [ ] The routed timing report for the 10.0 ns clock shows setup slack (WNS) ≥ 0 ns and hold slack (WHS) ≥ 0 ns.

## Correctness
- [ ] Preserve the ports, parameter defaults, and synchronous reset behavior; pass the provided testbench’s cycle checks and report `TEST PASSED`.
- [ ] Static/interface checks and compilation pass using the fixed provided testbench, tools, device, and constraints, without modifying the harness.

## Code quality
- [ ] Synthesis of top module `counter` for `xc7a35tcpg236-1` completes without unresolved synthesis errors.

## Definition of done

All hard-gate checklist items pass with evidence from the fixed simulation and Vivado reports; report the routed LUT count as the advisory optimization result.
